definitions.gloss: to supervise; to oversee; to manage
definitions.explanation: To watch over and manage people or work to ensure things are done properly. Used in workplaces, organizations, and institutional contexts.

definitions.gloss: to direct (a film, play, or sports team)
definitions.explanation: To serve as the director of a movie, theatrical production, or as the manager/coach of a sports team.

notes:
Both the noun ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ (director, supervisor, manager) and the verb {監督|かんとく}する are extremely common. The noun form is used as a title in both film and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{監督|かんとく}する: to supervise construction
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{監督|かんとく}する: to direct a film
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{監督|かんとく}する: to manage a team
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: supervisory responsibility
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧{不行届|ふゆきとどき}: inadequate supervision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧: to manage, administer — focuses on systems and processes
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to instruct, guide — emphasizes teaching
- ⟦{統率|とうそつ}する→統率する：17858_tousotsusuru⟧: to lead, command — emphasizes leadership over a group

USAGE:
As a noun, ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ is used as a title: ⟦{映画監督|えいがかんとく}→映画監督：07093_eigakantoku⟧ (film director), ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ (baseball manager).
